title: Thermacell E-ZoneGuard Patio+ Rechargeable Mosquito Repeller (E65)
writeup: Woot has the Thermacell E-ZoneGuard Patio+ rechargeable mosquito repeller (model E65, UPC 843654009827) for $14.99. It runs on a 6.5-hour rechargeable battery and comes with a charging dock and 36 hours of repellent refills. The cheapest in-stock price we found elsewhere is $35.85 at Drifters Gear, with Walmart at $44.97. Limit 3 per order.
